title: Find Middle C
intro: Middle C is the C closest to the middle of your keyboard. Look for a group of TWO black keys near the centre: middle C is the white key just to the LEFT of them. Put your right thumb (finger 1) on it and play it each time the app asks.
tips: Lift your thumb between notes so each one is a fresh key press.
On most keyboards middle C is right under the brand name.
